note: Switch "contingents" (test 5, docs/council/2026-11-27-units-ground-navy.md part 1, thread 47). An army is a few named contingents, each with a heart read from its town or faction (never rolled). Carthage puts an envoy on your worst-hearted contingent a season ahead; when battle is joined it turns unless you bound it with hostages, pay or a friend at the head of its town (Sekigahara's loyalty challenge; the Campanians held by hostages, Diodorus 14.61.6; the Sicels who went over in a body, 14.58.1). In a lost battle the worst-hearted part breaks first; a town's levy before its own walls fights harder (13.60.4); a town's levy far from home goes home unless paid (Hannibal: Rome vs Carthage; 13.88.7). Every number is invention.
